variants=[('skip-raw-reduction','let reduced=self.publication_reduce(ty);','let reduced=ty;',

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-prepared-publication-path').read_text().strip())
source = root/'source'
label = sys.argv[1]
assert not (root/(label+'.json')).exists(), label
def hashes():
    result = {}
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ('target', '.git')]
        for name in sorted(files):
            if name.endswith('.rs'):
                p = Path(directory)/name
                result[str(p.relative_to(source))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return result
before = hashes()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS'] = '2'
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(source/'target')
command = sys.argv[2:]
start = time.time()
with (root/(label+'.stdout')).open('w') as out, (root/(label+'.stderr')).open('w') as err:
    p = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    print(json.dumps({'label':label,'pid':p.pid,'command':command}),flush=True)
    code = p.wait()
after = hashes()
record = {'label':label,'pid':p.pid,'command':command,'returncode':code,'seconds':time.time()-start,
          'source_hashes_before':before,'source_hashes_after':after,'source_unchanged_during_run':before==after,
          'stdout':(root/(label+'.stdout')).read_text(),'stderr':(root/(label+'.stderr')).read_text()}
(root/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert before == after
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('label','returncode','seconds','source_unchanged_during_run')}))
print(record['stdout'][-6000:])
print(record['stderr'][-2000:])
